figurative_meaning_en: A boy born in the eighth month
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আটাশে ছেলে হওয়ায় তার শরীর দুর্বল ছিল।
গ্রামে আটাশে ছেলে জন্মলে সবাই চিন্তিত হয়ে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: He was an eight-month baby, so his body was weak.
In the village, everyone gets worried if a boy is born prematurely in the eighth month.
note: This idiom refers to a premature birth, common in rural Bengali contexts to describe early deliveries.
